title: FOMC decision (meeting Sep 14-15, with SEP) — the Wednesday of September triple-witching week, and the meeting that publishes the first 2030 dot
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, RE-FETCHED DIRECT 2026-09-06 by this session (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes) and re-parsed panel-by-panel rather than inherited from the proposal. The 2027 panel reads verbatim "January 26-27 | March 16-17* | April 27-28 | June 8-9* | July 27-28 | September 14-15* | October 26-27 | December 7-8*" under the page's own footnote "* Meeting associated with a Summary of Economic Projections." -- September 14-15 CARRIES an asterisk and therefore a SEP. Page's own stamp: "Last Update: August 19, 2026". Sep 14 2027 is a Tuesday and Sep 15 a Wednesday, consistent with the two-day convention. BYTE-COUNT DISCREPANCY RESOLVED, not smoothed: the seeding proposal recorded this page at 166,936 bytes on 2026-09-06 and flagged that five sibling ledgers had recorded 164,831 on the same date; this session's independent fetch returns 164,831, so the proposal's figure is the outlier and the chain's long-standing number stands. Filed estimate not for want of a primary but because the same page states verbatim "Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it" -- the confirming venue is the 2027-07-27/28 meeting, not a better fetch. The 14:00 ET statement time is NOT on this page; it is corroborated by a venue rather than a Board primary -- Kalshi's KXFEDDECISION-27SEP contracts close 2027-09-15T17:59:00Z (13:59 ET) with expected settlement 18:05:00Z (14:05 ET), read direct from the exchange API this session. notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-2027-09-15 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/fomc-2027-09-15.from-consumer-confidence-2027-09-28.json, which is now inert. Its claims were re-derived from the primaries rather than inherited and all held except its byte count (see source). WHAT THIS RESEARCH ADDS. (1) THE MEASURED DELIVERABLE, AND IT CORRECTS TWO SIBLING TABLES WITHOUT EDITING THEM: September's mean/median ratio of 1.01 -- the LOWEST of any month in the table fomc-2027-07-28 published, and the natural read of 'September's mean is trustworthy' -- IS A MIXTURE ARTIFACT. The 19 September decision days 2007-2025 are two populations: 5 pre-2012 no-SEP Septembers (2007-2011, every one a GFC/euro-crisis year) at mean 1.775% / median 1.752%, and 14 SEP-carrying Septembers 2012-2025 at mean 0.657% / median 0.395%. On the subsample 2027 actually belongs to the ratio is 1.66, ABOVE the 2012-2025 unconditional 1.28 and above the full-sample 1.42. The deployable number is the modern one: a September FOMC decision day's base rate is 0.66% mean / 0.40% median, not the 0.95% cell fomc-2027-06-09 tabulated -- that cell is 45% high and the excess is carried entirely by five crisis-era Septembers. Era-controlled the level is NOT significant either (permutation P = 0.26 against the 2012-2025 pool of 116), and the middle-band share is 0.429 against 0.431 -- dead even. SEPTEMBER IS THE ORDINARY MEETING: no level effect, no shape effect, which is exactly why its mean is usable and why no month-cell adjustment belongs in front of it. (2) THE CORRIDOR RULE IS REFUTED FOR THE CLASS, not just withdrawn for a meeting. fomc-2027-03-17 deployed 'treat the decision and the expiry as one event window' on a +2 March; fomc-2027-06-09 withdrew it as 'not this meeting's shape' at +6. September 2027 IS that shape -- the decision is exactly two days before September's third Friday, 2027-09-17 -- so the rule would reinstate itself by default. This session tested it and refuses: across all 77 quarterly-month decision days, inside-expiry-week (n=49) runs mean 1.072% against outside (n=28) 0.844%, but permutation P = 0.163 and it REVERSES inside September itself (inside 0.795 vs outside 1.092); the exact +2 shape (n=39) runs 0.861% against 0.925% unconditionally -- SMALLER, not larger. The rule is dead on evidence and should not be re-derived by the next lane that notices the calendar shape. (3) THE CALENDAR FACT, exact on two published calendars: the September FOMC has crossed September triple witching. Decision-to-third-Friday gaps run -3 or -5 (decision AFTER expiry) in 2009, 2010, 2011, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2021, 2022, 2023 and +1/+2/+3/+8 (decision BEFORE) otherwise; 2024, 2025, 2026 and 2027 are all exactly +2, the longest unbroken +2 run in the 21 years parsed here (previous best: two). (4) THE SEP HORIZON EXTENDS HERE. The Board's projections FAQ (fetched this session, HTTP 200, 84,788 bytes) states verbatim "The projections made in September and December are for the current year, for the subsequent three years, and for the longer run" against March/June's "subsequent two years" -- so 2027-09-15 publishes 2027/2028/2029/2030/LR and is THE MEETING AT WHICH THE 2030 DOT FIRST EXISTS. This inverts fomc-2027-06-09 leg 6: Mar->Jun 2027 is an artifact-free dot comparison, Jun->Sep 2027 is not. Tested and NOT significant as a move effect (horizon-extension SEP meetings 0.875% vs pure-revision 0.696%, P = 0.144) -- it is an attribution rule, not a volatility one. (5) THE CORRIDOR WAS EMPTY AND SHOULD NOT HAVE BEEN. The +/-5-day window (2027-09-10 -> 2027-09-20) returned ZERO tracked events before this PR, because the expiration class stopped at opex-2027-06-17 and vix-expiration-2027-05-18. Two real dateable events sit in it and are proposed here as estimates: vix-expiration-2027-09-15, ON THIS DECISION DAY (Cboe's own rule text re-sourced this session reproduces 9 of 9 listed VX settlements; third Friday of October 2027 is 2027-10-15, less 30 days is Wednesday 2027-09-15, and NYSE's published 2027 calendar puts no holiday on either leg), and opex-2027-09-17, September's quarterly triple witching. Minutes fomc-minutes-2027-10-06 are proposed too -- the proposal explicitly assigned them to this lane -- on the Board's own three-week rule MEASURED rather than quoted: all 45 '(Released ...)' strings parsed give 42 of 45 at exactly D+21 and every one of those a Wednesday, with September 5 of 5. (6) VENUE, AND IT IS THE FAMILY'S OWN COUNTEREXAMPLE HOLDING: KXFEDDECISION-27SEP is the THINNEST live ladder of the twelve (open interest 1,732, thinner than 27JUN's 1,962) and it is single-peaked at no-change, where 27JUN is the only malformed book -- so depth is neither sufficient (27JUN is deeper and broken) nor necessary (27SEP is thinner and clean) for well-formedness. corr(log ladder OI, log H26/H25 mid ratio) replicates at -0.875, n=12, a third independent time. And the trap that produces it: the 13th listed ladder, 26JUL, is 'finalized' with degenerate 0.00/1.00 quotes on ~49m open interest; including it collapses the correlation to -0.479. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS EVERY OTHER RATE ENTRY: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates-keyed. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
